explanation: Keep the current value and tail iterator of every nonempty sorted array in a min heap. Emit the smallest current value and replace it with the next value from that same array.
timeComplexity: O(k + N log(k+1)) time for k input arrays and N total elements.
spaceComplexity: O(k) heap space, plus O(N) output.
